title: FloorPriceStrategyOutput
description: UPR recommendations output from the Floor-Price-Strategist.

analysis_summary.description: Single concise sentence describing the dominant pattern: GEO tier applied, decision rule triggered, directional recommendation.

upr_recommendations.description: One recommendation object per input inventory unit.

current_floor.description: Implied current floor price in USD (2 decimal places).

recommended_floor.description: Recommended new floor price in USD (2 decimal places).

expected_fill_rate_change.description: Directional fill rate change in percentage points (e.g., '-12 pp expected', '+38 pp expected').

expected_revenue_impact.description: Projected revenue delta as signed percentage (e.g., '+9.5%', '-2.1%'). Must contain + or - sign.
